newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ATHLETICS-PRIVALOVA TO MISS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PRIVALOVA TO MISS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: European double sprint champion Irina Privalova will miss the Athens world championships in August because of a leg injury, a Russian athletic federation official said on Wednesday.
Vadim Zelichyonok, the Russian squad's senior coach, said Privalova, 28, had undergone a muscle operation in her upper leg more than a week ago.
"It is a pity we failed to diagnose the muscle rupture earlier. She will definitely miss the world championships in August," he said.
Zelinchyonok said the team would be selected after trials in the town of Tula, south of Moscow, from July 7-10.
